review_provenance.inspection_summary: Read all 16 changed paths at depth (the 953-line unit suite: titles enumerated, ~5 load-bearing bodies read verbatim, whole file executed). risk_surfaces=core_workflow_state,gate_orchestration,review_lifecycle. Attacks: (a) append-only: grepped every writer of surface-violations.json across src/, test/, bin/; writeViolations private with one caller; appendReviewSurfaceViolation called only from recordReviewSurfaceViolationForClose in agent-review.js; no truncate/rewrite path. (b) fail-closed: readReviewSurfaceViolations 47-73: ENOENT reads clean, JSON.parse failure and non-array entries throw VIBEPRO_REVIEW_SURFACE_LEDGER_UNREADABLE; readReviewSurfaceViolationSummary converts only that code to a blocking summary so pr prepare cannot pass on corruption. (c) RSV-8: reconcileReviewSurfaceViolationPointers 192-227 is a real set-difference over lifecycle pointers with a distinct missing:<id> namespace; readStoryLifecyclePointers applies strict failure policy closing the one-malformed-byte bypass. (d) idempotency: dedup key checked before append (agent-review.js 1002-1004); keyed replay neither duplicates nor re-appends; unkeyed replay dies on already-closed guard. (e) executed node --test on ledger+orchestrator suites: 49/49; concurrency test fails without the mkdir lock; RSV-8 tests assert exact orphan id and kind; RSV-5 drives real pr prepare artifact. (f) locks: ledger uses story-level .surface-violations.lock with read-modify-write fully inside it; append vs lifecycle pointer stamp non-atomicity resolves fail-closed and is documented in architecture doc and Spec residual risk. Backward compat: buildReviewSurfaceIntegrityGate fails only when unacknowledged>0, so no-ledger and legacy-lifecycle repos pass; legacy counted as unevaluated_lifecycle_count so pass reason never overclaims. New gate node has incoming+outgoing edges, registered in nodes, requiredGates, collectUnresolvedRequiredGates. listExistingReviewStages filtered by REVIEW_STAGES so the lock dir cannot be mistaken for a stage. All close callers after assertRecognizedCloseReason verified migrated. Delta commit bb1a463f re-inspected on request: exactly one file, test/public-release-notes.test.js lines 64-67, the npm dist-tag regex pins beta.1 -> beta.2; verified the diff stat (1 file, +4/-4), that the new expectations match the npm latest/beta rows of docs/reference/version-history.md and docs/ja/reference/version-history.md on this branch, and that the commit touches no source, gate, ledger or owned artifact, so all three role verdicts hold. Second delta commit 42a4d181 re-inspected: exactly one file, test/e2e/story-vibepro-review-surface-violation-ledger-acceptance.spec.ts (+4/-2), widening the wrapper summary assertions from the spec-reporter form to accept both the spec and tap reporter forms ((?:i|#) fail 0) after CI Node 22 emitted the tap form; judged a reporter-format widening only, not a semantic loosening - both forms are node:test summary lines meaning zero failures, the pass-count floor >= 23 still binds, and the reporter-agnostic assert.doesNotMatch(/^not ok/m) guard remains, so falsifying power is intact and all three role verdicts hold at 42a4d181.
